_note: What a scroll, potion, wand or spellbook does, one plain line each (src/item_words.py). Keyed by the item's class, then its `effect` id (a spellbook by class alone); `by_id` holds the few kinds whose own handler differs from their effect's. `line` is the sentence on the Kit card, the read / quaff / zap menu card, the Lore page and the Encyclopedia; `short` is the Kit list's Effect column and the menu rows. Either may be a list of five, one per tier (the scroll's own `tier`, else its quiz tier). `tiers` are the handler's own ladders (index = tier - 1), with a `<name>_blessed` or `<name>_cursed` ladder where the blessing or the curse changes the number (used only when the copy's blessing is known). `blessed` / `cursed` are a note added after the line when the copy's blessing is known; `line_blessed` / `line_cursed` replace the line. Placeholders are filled by item_words from the item and the hero: {power} the item's dice, {turns} its turns as the handler lays them (a potion's cut by the status cap), {least} a heal's share of the hero's health, {damage} a wand's damage range (by its tier and the hero's Intelligence), {int_note} ' (more with Intelligence)' when no hero is given, {share} the earth's share of each creature's health, {ward} a family ward's words (data/wards.json), {also} what a protection rite also keeps off, {family} the family a tune or a clash drives off, {sight} the light status's sight. Keep every line TRUE to its handler: src/game_magic.py (_apply_scroll_effect, _apply_wand_effect), src/game_wards.py (_mm_scroll, _mm_wand, _protection_also), src/food_system.py (drink_potion) and src/game_menus.py (the quiz draughts). tests/test_item_words.py pins the ladders and the numbers to them. Plain player text: no code ids, no 'tier'; he, she or it for one creature.
fallback: What it does is not written down.

dead_sea_map.line: Shows you the layout of every floor of the dungeon: this one at once, each other one as you arrive.

family_rout.line: Every {family} in sight flees in fear for {turns} turns.

heal.line: Heals {power} health, or {least} if that is more.
heal.blessed: Blessed, it heals half again as much.
heal.cursed: Cursed, it heals half as much.

extra_heal.line: Heals {power} health, or {least} if that is more.
extra_heal.blessed: Blessed, it heals half again as much.
extra_heal.cursed: Cursed, it heals half as much.

full_heal.blessed: Blessed, it first clears every ailment too.
full_heal.line_cursed: Cursed, it heals only half the health you are missing.

restore_sp.blessed: Blessed, it restores half again as much.
restore_sp.cursed: Cursed, it restores half as much.

cure_all.line: Cures every ailment at once: poison, disease, fear, confusion, a hex and the rest.

haste.line: Hastes you for {turns} turns: monsters act half as often.

invisibility.line: Makes you invisible for {turns} turns: a foe not beside you cannot see you, and you gain 2 points of armour.

regeneration.line: You regenerate for {turns} turns, mending a little health every 3 turns.

heroism.line: Makes you Heroic for {turns} turns: STR +2.

levitation.line: You float for {turns} turns, above every trap in the floor.

see_invisible.line: For {turns} turns you see creatures that are invisible.

fire_resist.line: For {turns} turns fire does you half harm, and you cannot be set alight.

cold_resist.line: For {turns} turns cold does you half harm, and you cannot be frozen.

shock_resist.line: For {turns} turns lightning does you half harm.

restore_str.line: Gives back the Strength that disease or a draining potion took.

gain_level.line: Lifts you bodily up to the floor above.

teleport.line: Throws you to a random place on this floor.

restoration.line: Gives back every stat point a drain, a poison or a disease took, and the health the life-draining dead took; it cures disease too.

treasure_sight.line: Marks every treasure, chest and coin pile on this floor on your map.

confusion.line: Harmful: confuses you for {turns} turns, so your steps go astray.

blindness.line: Harmful: blinds you for {turns} turns, so you see only the tiles beside you.

poison.line: Harmful: poisons you for {turns} turns, and you lose {per_turn} each turn.

paralysis.line: Harmful: paralyzes you for {turns} turns, unless your Constitution throws it off.

hallucination.line: Harmful: for {turns} turns monsters wear wrong faces, and your quizzes grow a false answer that fades.

sleep.line: Harmful: puts you to sleep for {turns} turns, unless your Constitution throws it off; a blow wakes you.

weakness.line: Harmful: weakens you for {turns} turns, so your blows do half damage.

slow.line: Harmful: slows you for {turns} turns, so every action takes two turns.

sickness.line: Harmful: sickens you for {turns} turns: rest does not heal you, most healing is halved, and it may sap your STR or CON.

fumbling.line: Harmful: for {turns} turns you drop the first thing you handle, unless you stand in Guard.

fear.line: Harmful: frightens you for {turns} turns, unless your Wisdom throws it off; you cannot go nearer to a foe or strike one unless cornered.

drain_str.line: Harmful: takes {amount} of your STR away, until a potion of restore strength, a physician or the Water of Epidaurus gives it back.

drain_con.line: Harmful: takes {amount} of your CON away, until a physician or the Water of Epidaurus gives it back.

drain_wis.line: Harmful: takes {amount} of your WIS away, until a physician or the Water of Epidaurus gives it back.

drain_int.line: Harmful: takes {amount} of your INT away, until a physician or the Water of Epidaurus gives it back.

antidote.line: Cures poison and disease, and no poison or disease can take you for {turns} turns.

clear_mind.line: Clears confusion, charm and false sights, and none of them can take hold of you for {turns} turns.

fearless.line: Clears fear, and nothing can frighten you for {turns} turns.

fireproof.line: For {turns} turns fire cannot hurt you, and you are Shielded: 2 points of armour, and blows do half their harm.

stoneproof.line: Stops stone creeping into you, and nothing can turn you to stone for {turns} turns.

styx_dipped.line: For {turns} turns physical blows, bites and claws cannot wound you; fire, venom, magic and an unseen blow at your heel still can.

wakeful.line: Wakes you, and nothing can put you to sleep for {turns} turns.

fafnirs_blood.line: Drinking it asks a run of animal questions: the more you answer, the more the birds tell you, from closing every wound to gifts that last. Answer none, and it only scalds you.
fafnirs_blood.short: The birds' speech, by animal questions

mimir_wisdom.line: Drinking it asks one {quiz_subjects} question: right, {quiz_stat} +{quiz_amount} for good; wrong, it is wasted.

acid_spray.line: Acid burns one foe for {damage} damage{int_note}, and leaves it Diseased for {dis_turns} turns.

cancellation.line: Strips one foe of every magic that helps it, such as haste or a shield.

dispel_magic.line: Strips one foe of every magic that helps it, such as haste or a shield.

drain_magic.line: Strips one foe of every magic that helps it, such as haste or a shield.

charm_monster.line: Charms one foe for {turns} turns: it will not strike you, and it wanders. Bosses, the mightiest, the undead and the mindless cannot be charmed.

cold_bolt.line: A bolt of cold strikes one foe for {damage} damage{int_note} and slows it for {slow_turns} turns.

curse_monster.line: Curses one foe for {turns} turns, so it misses more, and slows it for {slow_turns} turns.

death_ray.line: Slays one foe outright 85 times in 100; otherwise it takes half its health. Bosses and the mightiest are never slain outright, and take less.

digging.line: Blasts away every wall and door on the 8 tiles around you.
digging.short: Digs out the walls around you

disease_monster.line: Diseases one foe for {turns} turns, and takes a fifth of its health at once.

disintegrate.line: Destroys one foe outright 70 times in 100; otherwise it takes a third of its health. Bosses and the mightiest are never destroyed outright, and take less.

drain_life.line: Drains {damage} health from one foe{int_note}, and heals you by what it takes; the undead have less to give.

family_rout.line: Every {family} in sight flees in fear for {turns} turns. The din is loud: sleepers hear it.

fear_monster.line: Frightens one foe for {turns} turns: it turns and flees. Bosses and the mightiest stand their ground.

fire_bolt.line: A bolt of fire strikes one foe for {damage} damage{int_note}.

heal.line: Heals you {power}, or {least} if that is more.

iron_mortar.line: Never the same twice: it may heal you, haste you, mend you over time, put every foe in sight to sleep, blast every foe in sight, teleport you, or confuse you.
iron_mortar.short: A wild magic, never the same

light.line: Lights you up for {turns} turns: sight +{sight}, and you are seen from farther.

lightning_bolt.line: Lightning strikes every creature in a line to one foe for {damage} damage{int_note}, and stuns each one it hurts for 3 turns.

magic_missile.line: A missile that never misses strikes one foe for {damage} damage{int_note}.

opening.line: Opens every door and unlocks every locked chest in sight.
opening.short: Opens doors and chests in sight

polymorph_monster.line: Turns one foe into a random creature that could live on this floor. Bosses and the mightiest resist.

probing.line: Reads the nearest foe's health, weaknesses and resistances, and teaches you its kind as studying its corpse would.

secret_door_detection.line: Reveals every secret door {radius}, through walls too.

sleep_monster.line: Puts one foe to sleep for {turns} turns ({boss_cap}).

striking.line: A blow of force strikes one foe for {damage} damage{int_note}.

sunlight.line: Floods the whole floor with light: maps it, shows every creature on it and strips its invisibility, and you see the invisible for {see_turns} turns.

teleport_monster.line: Sends one foe to a random place on this floor.

turn_undead.line: Holy light strikes every undead in sight for {damage} damage{int_note}, and sends each fleeing for {fear_turns} turns.

unstring_monster.line: For {turns} turns one foe's bows, slings and thrown weapons will not answer it.

weaken_monster.line: Weakens one foe for {turns} turns, so its blows do half damage.

wonder.line: Each zap is one of ten random magics: it may heal you, haste you, shield you, hide you, mend you over time or teleport you; or burn, confuse or put to sleep the foes in sight, or shock the nearest.

time_stop.line: Stops time for {turns} turns: monsters cannot act.

philosophers_wrench.line: A tool, not magic: it asks no question. It joins two pieces that were meant to become one.

wand_notes.cursed: Cursed, 3 zaps in 100 misfire and waste the charge.

thrown._note: A potion thrown at a foe (CombatMixin._apply_thrown_potion): the throw menu's row.
thrown.debuff: Thrown, it leaves a foe {status} for {turns} turns

buff_used.levitating: Thrown, it makes a foe float

thrown.teleport: Thrown, it sends a foe elsewhere on the floor
thrown.drain: Thrown, it takes a twentieth of a foe's health
thrown.none: Thrown, it does nothing to a foe

potion_notes.harm_blessed: Blessed, it does you no harm.
potion_notes.drain_blessed: Blessed, it does you no harm.
potion_notes.binary_blessed: Blessed, one time in 4 a dose is left over.
potion_notes.binary_cursed: Cursed, one time in 4 it does nothing.

spellbook.cost_taxed: Each cast costs {base_mp} MP ({mp} in your metal armour).

reach.touch: Aimed: you must touch the foe.
reach.sight: Aimed: it reaches as far as you can see.

wand_of_panic_wave.line: Frightens every creature in sight for {turns} turns: each turns and flees. Bosses, the mightiest and the fearless stand their ground.

lantern_of_diogenes.line: Lights you up for {turns} turns: sight +{sight}, and you are seen from farther; for as long, you see the invisible.

flux_capacitor.line: Stops time for {turns} turns: monsters cannot act. It asks no question.

book_of_thoth.line: Read once: everything you carry, wear and stand on is identified, every creature you have met opens its page in the Bestiary, and every wand you carry is filled. Misread, it hurts you, makes you forget three kinds of thing, and stuns you for 20 turns.
